api:
<RadiationPattern data={lobes} angle={|l: &Lobe| l.angle}>
    <TrendSeries name="E-plane" y={|l: &Lobe| l.e_plane} />
    <TrendSeries name="H-plane" y={|l: &Lobe| l.h_plane} />
</RadiationPattern>
PropTypeDefault
datarequired
angleFn(&T) -> f64: degrees, clockwise from the toprequired
children<TrendSeries>: gain in dB, one pattern eachrequired
maxf64: dB at the rimthe highest gain, rounded up to 10
minf64: dB at the centremax − 40
levelsusize: dB rings4
fill_opacity, line_width0.1, 2.
legend, tooltip, classas on <Spider>

Spokes every 30°, rings labelled in dB. A pattern that covers the full circle is closed and filled. Hover to read every pattern's gain at the nearest angle.

examples.title: Dipole and array
examples.description: Gain in dB against angle; the array's narrow main lobe and side lobes show clearly.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn antennas() {
    let data = use_signal(lobes());
    rsx! {
        <RadiationPattern data={data} angle={|l: &Lobe| l.angle} class="h-96">
            <TrendSeries name="Dipole" y={|l: &Lobe| l.dipole} />
            <TrendSeries name="4-element array" y={|l: &Lobe| l.array} />
        </RadiationPattern>
    }
}

examples.title: 20 dB range
examples.description: A shallower range and filled patterns for near-omnidirectional antennas.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn shallow() {
    let data = use_signal(lobes());
    rsx! {
        <RadiationPattern data={data} angle={|l: &Lobe| l.angle} min={-20.} levels={4} fill_opacity={0.25} class="h-96">
            <TrendSeries name="Omni" y={|l: &Lobe| l.omni} />
            <TrendSeries name="Dipole" y={|l: &Lobe| l.dipole} />
        </RadiationPattern>
    }
}

examples.title: Dipole
examples.description: A single figure-eight pattern from −30 to 0 dB.
examples.code:
#[component]

        </RadiationPattern>
    }
}
